bounds.name: Request, subscription, simulation, and stream queue bounds

values.accounting: pending captured SSE items per simulation

deterministicFailure.contract: A frame above the derived byte capacity is rejected before retention; one terminal frame retains an independent reserved lane.

values.accounting: production JSON output plus six-byte data prefix and two-byte suffix

deterministicFailure.contract: Application and framework results are structurally preflighted and exactly serialized before response commitment; oversized values map to sanitized internal errors without retaining application canaries.

bounds.name: Serialized application and framework result bounds

values.accounting: combined Base64 characters across one result
one Base64 scalar before JSON quoting
largest raw scalar whose Base64 encoding fits the scalar ceiling

deterministicFailure.contract: Nonpositive or nanosecond-unrepresentable durations fail configuration; elapsed deadlines close or terminate their owned work with fixed outcomes.

bounds.name: Transport, request, and subscription time bounds

values.accounting: absolute request deadline from transport acceptance
effective public-server interval without a successful stream write
absolute subscription lifetime across events and keep-alives

deterministicFailure.contract: Typed conversion fails with a sanitized binding error before bounded container or record scratch allocation.

values.accounting: rendered prefix of one escaped diagnostic path segment before an ellipsis
class-file bytes read for enum declaration order

deterministicFailure.contract: Invalid or oversized URIs/templates fail construction or request mapping; exhausted match/overlap work fails closed before unbounded search.

bounds.name: Resource URI and Level 1 URI-template bounds

values.accounting: one annotation-constant exact resource URI below the class-file modified-UTF ceiling
discovered states across endpoint overlap validation
discovered states per pairwise overlap comparison
one template source or normalized expansion
one URI routed through a template

matcherRules.description: Byte, short, int, long, BigInteger, or Duration fields explicitly declared with static and final in either modifier order whose identifier contains MAXIMUM or MINIMUM, plus derived declarations classified by FINITE-MATCH-004.

Components named maximum*, minimum*, *Capacity, *Concurrency, *Timeout, *Deadline, *Duration, *Interval, *Resolution, *Backlog, or *BufferSize on MCP records whose type name ends in Config, Configuration, or Limits.

Public methods on direct src/main/java/com/soklet/Mcp*.java Builder types whose method or parameter name matches the FINITE-MATCH-002 bound-name vocabulary; method members include declared parameter-type signatures.

Derived or mirrored typed constants and computed methods, production JSON-limit projections, SokletProcessor copies, the HTTP framing allowance, and the localization callback-count mirror; this family takes priority over the other families.
